headline: Mooring County Reduced to Lone Colonial Post as Expanse Rages
war_summary: Since our last edition went to press, Mooring County's ledger has turned sharply: the Colonials' second post has fallen and the ruined ground stands rebuilt, leaving the Wardens eleven strongholds to one. The guns there were heard within the half-hour before filing — six post actions in two hours, Gravekeeper's Holdfast the busiest — with the day's roll at 5,941 Colonial and 5,254 Warden fallen and hourly losses still climbing. The Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest field: five Warden posts and one Colonial against three grounds now demolished, fifty recorded actions in the day, Wightwalk most worked over at eighteen, and twenty-four-hour losses of 8,627 against 11,410. The Nevish Line's posts stand as filed, five to three, though casualty columns climb at near two hundred the hour apiece. Callahan's Passage rests uneasily at nine to one after Crumbling Post endured fifteen actions; Palantine Berm logged thirty movements past one o'clock, its seven posts holding for the Wardens. Kuura Strand, Fisherman's Row and Stlican Shelf show no post actions since the afternoon, though Shelf casualty figures still rise steeply. It is day 539; the thirty-four victory towns remain unclaimed and no victor is named.
